name: Shemed
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Shemed was a descendant of Benjamin, the youngest son of Jacob. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the heads of the tribe of Benjamin who lived in Aijalon and drove out the inhabitants of Gath. He is known as a builder who constructed Ono and Lod along with their surrounding villages.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shemed is listed as one of the sons of Elpaal in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Built the cities of Ono and Lod
keyEvents.description: Shemed built the cities of Ono and Lod along with their surrounding villages, showing his role as a significant leader and builder in the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Drove out the inhabitants of Gath
keyEvents.description: Shemed helped drive out the inhabitants of Gath, demonstrating that the descendants of Benjamin were active in defending and expanding their territory.

keyEvents.title: Head of the family in Aijalon
keyEvents.description: Shemed and his relatives were among the heads who lived in Aijalon, an important city in the territory of Benjamin.
